text:
Aisha: quick idea dump: feed ML risk scores into the edge rate decision but need to balance latency, fairness, and safety.
Ben: agree. primary tradeoff sync per-request vs async token refresh. edge SLO is ~30ms p95 so sync heavy models won't work.
Claire: propose hybrid: tiny edge model for soft signals + server-side model that writes tenant risk tokens (score+confidence+ttl). admission applies normalization.
Diego: contract sketch: POST /v1/score {tenant,req_id,features?} -> {score,confidence,model,ttl_s,tags}. edge caches token for ttl.
Aisha: rollout plan: telemetry-only -> shadow apply -> limited canary multipliers -> full. also offline replay to evaluate fairness.
Ben: safety: enforce a floor on quota reductions (e.g., not below 60%) unless human review. log model_version+hashed_features for debug.
Claire: privacy: never send raw text; use hashed features/embeddings. require mTLS + KMS for scoring endpoints.
Diego: infra: regional replicas + local sidecar cache. quorum reads for strict decisions, single-replica for soft decisions.
ops-bot: deploybot: canary score-v1 deployed to us-east1 1/4 replicas at 2026-03-25T12:03Z
Aisha: i'll draft RFC with API, cache TTLs, normalization hooks, telemetry schema, replay job, and rollback playbook. comments welcome.
